source_text: For neonatal circumcision specifically, meta-analyses indicate a 90-99% relative risk reduction in urinary tract infections (UTIs) during the first year of life, with absolute risk dropping from about 1% in uncircumcised infants to 0.1% post-procedure; this protective effect persists into later childhood at a 6-7 fold reduction. [120]
